title: ARESHealthTelemetryPacket
description: Standardized biometric, environmental, and provenance-tagged telemetry packet transmitted from ares-engine (Safe Rust) to ares-cockpit (React / Three.js) and local MCP agents. Compliant with Issue #4 reproducible BIDMC replay and provenance separation rules.

timestamp_ms.description: Replay engine wall-clock tick in milliseconds (distinct from original recording acquisition time; never fabricated as an original clinical timestamp).

relative_recording_time_s.description: Original relative time in seconds from the start of the recording (e.g. 0 to 480 s for BIDMC numeric CSVs).

source_record_id.description: Explicit source recording identifier (e.g. 'bidmc_01', 'bidmc_02', 'bidmc_03', or 'SIM-SCENARIO-MARS-184'). Unrelated records are never merged into a fictitious longitudinal patient.

mission_elapsed_days.description: Simulated mission elapsed day when running What-If deep-space scenario overlays (null when running pure terrestrial BIDMC replay).

astronaut_id.description: Identifier of the monitored crew member or terrestrial replay subject.

biometrics_source.description: Explicit provenance of the primary biometric vitals.

biometrics_native_rate_hz.description: True native sample rate of the underlying biometric source in Hz (e.g. 1.0 Hz for BIDMC Numerics CSV, 125.0 Hz for BIDMC Waveforms).

ui_refresh_rate_hz.description: Cockpit UI stream tick rate in Hz (e.g. 1.0 Hz or 20.0 Hz; never misrepresents a 1 Hz source as 20 Hz sensor acquisition).

scenario_overlay_mode.description: Indicates whether simulated deep-space scenario inputs (hemodynamics, musculoskeletal, habitat avionics) are active alongside recorded vitals.

heart_rate_bpm.description: Recorded ECG-derived heart rate in bpm (BIDMC ' HR' column). Null if sensor value is missing/invalid.

pulse_rate_bpm.description: Recorded PPG-derived pulse rate in bpm (BIDMC ' PULSE' column; e.g. 13 missing rows in bidmc_01 remain explicitly null/UNAVAILABLE).

respiration_rate_brpm.description: Recorded impedance respiration rate in breaths per minute (BIDMC ' RESP' column). Null if unavailable.

spo2_percent.description: Recorded peripheral oxygen saturation percentage (BIDMC ' SpO2' column; e.g. 13 missing rows in bidmc_01 remain explicitly null/UNAVAILABLE).

rr_interval_ms.description: Beat-to-beat R-R interval in milliseconds. Must be null unless derived from 125 Hz+ ECG waveform R-peaks.

hrv_rmssd_ms.description: Root mean square of successive beat-interval differences in ms. Null for 1 Hz numeric-only replay; no HR/respiration proxy. Current Rust baseline serializes this indicator as rmssd_ms; full wire alignment remains issue #8.

rmssd_ms.description: Unavailable (null) in numeric-only BIDMC replay: beat intervals or appropriate waveform processing are not provided. Current Rust name for hrv_rmssd_ms.

sdnn_ms.description: Unavailable (null) in numeric-only BIDMC replay: beat intervals or appropriate waveform processing are not provided. Must not be derived from a proxy RMSSD.

pnn50_pct.description: Unavailable (null) in numeric-only BIDMC replay: beat intervals or appropriate waveform processing are not provided. Must not be derived from a proxy RMSSD.

lf_hf_ratio.description: Unavailable (null) in numeric-only BIDMC replay: beat intervals or appropriate waveform processing are not provided. Must not be derived from a proxy RMSSD.

hrv_unavailable_reason.description: Why numeric-source HRV is unavailable; separate from sensor dropout. A high numeric SQI does not make beat intervals available.

core_temp_celsius.description: Core body temperature in Celsius (null if not present in the recorded source).

missing_channels.description: List of channel names that are unavailable/NaN at the current sample tick (e.g. ['pulse_rate_bpm', 'spo2_percent'] in bidmc_01).

hemodynamics.description: Simulated or POCUS-entered jugular hemodynamic state (explicitly tagged with provenance; null in pure BIDMC replay mode).

ijv_csa_cm2.description: Internal Jugular Vein Cross-Sectional Area in cm^2 (scenario input).

ijv_velocity_max_cm_s.description: Peak jugular blood flow velocity in cm/s (scenario input).

wall_shear_stress_dyn_cm2.description: Derived endothelial wall shear stress tau_w = 2 * mu * v_max * sqrt(pi / IJV_CSA) in dyn/cm^2.

pocus_thrombus_confirmed.description: Hard Safety Gate 1 input: whether POCUS confirms a non-compressible intraluminal thrombus.

thrombosis_risk_score.description: Derived Virchow's Triad stasis indicator in [0, 1].

musculoskeletal.description: Simulated What-If musculoskeletal scenario state (null in pure BIDMC replay mode).

environment.description: Simulated habitat environmental avionics state (null in pure BIDMC replay mode).

med_stl_rho_robustness.description: Normalized Quantitative Satisfaction (NQS-STL) degree in (-inf, +1.0] computed over available channels.

time_to_violation_days.description: Estimated remaining days before critical boundary violation (null when evaluating 8-minute terrestrial BIDMC recordings).

alarm_level.description: Deterministic alert tier including explicit DATA_DEGRADED_MISSING_CHANNELS when required inputs are null.

nqs_stl.description: Current Rust baseline assessment block. Complete composite and dependent forecasts remain null when HRV is absent or invalid. Full transport reconciliation with safety_margins remains #8.

rho_rmssd.description: Null when required valid HRV is unavailable. No healthy default or renormalized composite.

rho_global.description: Null when required valid HRV is unavailable. No healthy default or renormalized composite.

ttv_hours.description: Null when required valid HRV is unavailable. No healthy default or renormalized composite.

ttv_ci95_low_hours.description: Null when required valid HRV is unavailable. No healthy default or renormalized composite.

ttv_ci95_high_hours.description: Null when required valid HRV is unavailable. No healthy default or renormalized composite.

mri_pct.description: Null when required valid HRV is unavailable. No healthy default or renormalized composite.

alert_severity.description: Current Rust baseline severity: missing HRV produces degraded assessment unless a known hazard requires warning/emergency. Other baseline wire differences remain #8.
